decisions.reason: Aircraft turnaround management is a core integrated operations tool with dedicated web presence and remains central to the firm's airside efficiency offering.
Revenue calculation and billing software is less central but still complements the service bundle and incurs low opportunity cost to maintain.
Apron equipment monitoring supports lifecycle and maintenance services, a key resource and revenue stream for the firm.
Apron resource management is close to established offerings and improves operational efficiency for airport customers.
Controller safety alerts meet regulatory and safety needs, enhancing customer trust and service differentiation.
